title: 第十一章肝经验第十二章气血生拳法入门
content_zh:
;;
听到李晴师姐的这番话，江宁笑了笑，并未多言。
从刚刚五禽拳的拳谱上他已经得知，这门拳谱唯有五势齐修，齐头并进才是最正确的修炼方式。
因为五势齐修，方能快速的凝练气血，气血壮大，贯通周身，才能武道入品，也唯有如此，才能不暴敛天物，浪费这本武道奠基的功法。
单修一势，确实在一势上更易精进，但是对于武道之路却是没有多大的帮助。
纵使虎形拳修炼至大成，一拳轰出神形具备，调动周身力量，可以爆发出寻常人数倍的力量又能如何？
体魄得不到锻炼，气血得不到壮大，身体素质终究比常人高不了多。
在气血贯通四肢的武者面前，所谓的拳法技巧，不过是如同小儿玩闹。
绝对的身体素质，可以碾压一切技巧。
气血贯通周身的武者，以力压人，随意一拳，便可以轰杀普通人。
所以江宁怎么可能听李晴的话，舍本而逐末。
有面板在，只要勤奋，只要肝经验，就能让五禽拳没有任何瓶颈的突破。
拳法每一次突破，所带来的气血凝练效果也会更上一层楼。
这才是他变强的根源。
有面板这个依仗，他又怎会与那些人这般，为了能通过考核，成为武馆真正的弟子，而去浪费时间修一门单一的拳法，单一的拳势。
五势齐修，五形并进，可以让他实力快速的提升，实力提升，才能无惧徐云峰等人的威胁。
随后。
站在前院，江宁摆开架势，调整状态准备习练五禽拳，肝取经验值，让这门拳法尽快的达到入门的层次。
此时此刻，前院的汉子看到江宁开始练拳，皆纷纷停下他们各自的练功，神色好奇的看了过来。
随着江宁开始练拳，顿时有人双目大睁。

“这小子不是中午才加入武馆吗？难道现在就已经记住了拳谱要义？”
“不急，看下去！”有人开口，依旧坚持自己之前的观点。
其余人更是认真的看着江宁练拳。
刚刚他们观摩完王老练拳后就一直在暗中议论江宁。
因为他们有人记得江宁是中午刚刚入门，而此刻只是下午，王老就亲自演练一遍五禽拳，这让他们不得不心生疑惑。
武馆新入门的弟子，唯有将五禽拳拳谱全部记住，方有资格让王老下场亲自演练一遍五禽拳。
此刻随着江宁一招一式的练拳，众人也从不信渐渐变成了相信。
“不可思议，他竟然真的在如此短暂的时间将拳谱彻底记住！”
“确实不可思议，而且他这一招一式，以及运用呼吸法之间的韵律，竟然完美符合拳谱上的记载，这天赋有些吓人啊！”
“......”
一众大汉见此，纷纷发出惊叹的声音。
而此刻身穿蓝色劲装的李晴却是眉头微蹙，因为此刻的江宁分明是在完整的练五禽拳，而非是其中一门的虎形拳。
看了一盏茶的功夫，她微微摇头。
大约十八岁的年龄才开始习武，已然落后别人三年以上的黄金习武年龄，还不知抓住机会！空有一副不错的皮囊，却是不会抓住机会改变自己的命运。
这一刻，她心中对于江宁充满了一股失望的情绪。
随即她转身离去。
此刻，同样有人注意到了李晴的神情。
毕竟一位如此高挑修长，气质甚佳的女子在武馆中必然会招来众多目光，甚至是暗生爱慕。
但是他们也知道这位女子身份必然极其富贵，远在他们之上，不是他们所能染指的，故没人有染指追求的想法，仅仅只能在暗中时不时偷看。
“李师姐这是为什么摇头啊？”有人低声的开口。

“这都看不出来吗？李师姐这是对这位师弟有些失望！”有人开口解释。
“为何失望啊？”那人面露疑惑。

Hearing what Senior Sister Li Qing said, Jiang Ning smiled and didn't say much.
He already knew from the Wu Qin Quan manual just now that the most correct way to practice this martial art is to practice the five forces together and go hand in hand.
Because the five forces can be cultivated together, only the Qi and blood can be quickly condensed, and the Qi and blood can be strengthened and penetrated throughout the body, and only then can the martial arts reach the top level. Only in this way can one avoid excessive use of natural resources and waste the skills that are the foundation of the martial arts.
It is true that it is easier to improve on one stance by simply cultivating one stance, but it does not help much on the road to martial arts.
Even if the tiger-shaped fist is practiced to a great extent, so what if one can punch out a divine form and mobilize the power of the whole body to explode with power that is multiple times that of an ordinary person?
If the body cannot be exercised and the qi and blood cannot be strengthened, the physical fitness will not be much higher than that of ordinary people.
In front of a warrior whose qi and blood penetrate his limbs, the so-called boxing skills are just like children's play.
Absolute physical fitness can crush all skills.
A warrior with energy and blood flowing through his body can overwhelm people with his strength, and can kill ordinary people with a random punch.
So how could Jiang Ning listen to Li Qing and abandon his roots to pursue his weaknesses?
With a panel, as long as you are diligent and experienced, Wu Qinquan can break through without any bottlenecks.
Every time a boxing breakthrough occurs, the energy and blood condensation effect will reach a higher level.
This is the source of his strength.
With the support of the panel, how could he be like those people, wasting time on practicing a single boxing technique and a single boxing position in order to pass the examination and become a true disciple of the martial arts school.
The five forces can be cultivated together and the five forms can advance together, allowing him to quickly improve his strength. Only when his strength increases can he not be afraid of the threats from Xu Yunfeng and others.
Subsequently.
Standing in the front yard, Jiang Ning set up his posture, adjusted his posture and prepared to practice Wuqinquan, gaining experience points to help this boxing technique reach the entry-level level as soon as possible.
At this moment, when the men in the front yard saw Jiang Ning starting to practice boxing, they all stopped their own exercises and looked over with curious expressions.
As Jiang Ning began to practice boxing, some people's eyes suddenly opened wide.
"Didn't this kid just join the martial arts gym at noon? Has he already memorized the essentials of the boxing manual?"
"Don't worry, keep reading!" Someone said, still insisting on his previous point of view.
The others watched Jiang Ning practice boxing seriously.
They had just been talking about Jiang Ning secretly after watching Mr. Wang practice boxing.
Because some of them remembered that Jiang Ning had just started at noon, but now it was only the afternoon, and Mr. Wang had personally practiced Wuqinquan, which made them doubtful.
New disciples of the martial arts school must memorize all the five-animal fist rules before they can be qualified to ask Mr. Wang to practice the five-animal fist in person.
At this moment, as Jiang Ning practiced each move, everyone gradually changed from disbelief to belief.
"It's incredible that he actually memorized the boxing rules completely in such a short period of time!"
"It's really unbelievable, and the rhythm between his moves and breathing techniques perfectly matches the records in the boxing book. This talent is a bit scary!"
"..."
Seeing this, all the big men exclaimed in amazement.
At this moment, Li Qing, who was wearing blue attire, frowned slightly, because at this moment, Jiang Ning was clearly practicing the complete Five-animal Fist, not one of the Tiger-Shaped Fist.
After looking at the cup of tea, she shook her head slightly.
He only started practicing martial arts when he was about 18 years old. He was already more than three years behind others' prime martial arts training age, and he still didn't know how to seize the opportunity! Kong has a good skin, but he will not seize the opportunity to change his destiny.
At this moment, her heart was filled with disappointment towards Jiang Ning.
Then she turned and left.
At this moment, someone also noticed Li Qing's expression.
After all, a woman with such a tall, slender and good temperament will inevitably attract many eyes and even secret admiration in the martial arts gym.
But they also knew that this woman’s identity must be extremelyIts wealth and honor are far above them and beyond their reach, so no one has any intention of pursuing it. They can only peek in the dark from time to time.
"Senior Sister Li, why are you shaking your head?" Someone asked in a low voice.
"Can't you tell? Senior sister Li is a little disappointed with this junior brother!" Someone explained.
"Why are you disappointed?" The man looked confused.
